title: Rebels Transcend
description: THE REBELS TRANSCEND evil in this concept (front) by Japanese artist Noriyoshi Ohrai. Even in its non-finished form and subdued color, this work for THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK shows an undeniable strength in its composition. Trying a different hue and featuring Darth Vader more prominently (back), Ohrai works to blend the Dark Lord in with the surrounding cosmos. The spacecraft is the artist's own version Of a Star Destroyer-type ship.
